skill_name: Give me a creative way to celebrate a birthday.
workflow: You could have a picnic in your backyard with all your friends and family, where all your favorite foods can be served. Get creative with decorations and prepare some fun games for everyone to play. You could organize a scavenger hunt to find hidden presents or a water balloon fight. At night, you and your friends can have a movie night with snacks, drinks and some of your favorite movies.
